description: A winter square at dusk or night. A bronze statue of a rearing horse and rider stands on a large granite boulder at right. Rows of soldiers in dark green coats and tall shako caps hold muskets, and some carry torches. An officer on a brown horse sits at the lower left. In the background are cannons with smoke, a domed cathedral with a gold dome, and a neoclassical building. There is no visible text, no frame, and no blood.
